publishedMetadata.title: Server errors and focus
publishedMetadata.description: Represent authoritative HTTP errors in accessible form feedback and restore focus to the first relevant input. This guided lab analyzes and repairs a real React Hook Form state or submission failure.
objectives: Represent authoritative HTTP errors in accessible form feedback and restore focus to the first relevant input.
Mock 422 then 503. The 422 path must set title error and focus; 503 must set root.server without claiming success.
Never print untrusted server error bodies as HTML; use trusted generic descriptions and text nodes for any constrained message.
